scanner_subtitle: Position your paper prescription or lab report under the kiosk lens, or upload a digital file scan.
drop_zone_desc: Drag and drop any physical prescription, laboratory test report, or hospital discharge summary. Accepts PDF, PNG, JPG, or WebP (up to 10MB).
ocr_running_desc: Extracting medical text, identifying abnormal lab values, dosages, and clinical diagnoses
camera_modal_guideline: Align paper document inside viewfinder frame
camera_paper_flat_hint: Ensure paper is flat and text is clearly readable
error_oversized_file: File size exceeds 10 MB limit. Please choose a smaller document scan.
error_invalid_format: Invalid file format. Please upload a valid medical image (PNG, JPG, WebP) or PDF document.
error_read_failed: Failed to read file from your device.
error_ocr_process: Error processing document with OCR. Please try again.
